When wielded, it fires arrows of pure light strong enough to oppose the Calamity.|Allies|AoC}}{{Name Ref|SSBB, HWDE, SSBfN3DS, SSBfWU}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{TMC|-}}=== The Bow of Light is obtained alongside the [[Light Arrow]]s in {{TMC}}. To obtain them, [[Link]] must [[Kinstone Fusion|Fuse]] [[Kinstone]]s with [[Strato]], a man who lives in a house in western [[Hyrule Town]]. This will open a portal in [[South Hyrule Field]] that leads to the [[Home of the Wind Tribe]] in the [[Cloud Tops]].{{Cite|Goodness! We rarely get visitors here. Tell me, how did you get here?|Hailey|TMC}} Here, Link can use the [[Gust Jar]] to suck in the ghost circling [[Gregal]], saving his life; if Link visits Gregal again after reaching the Cloud Tops through [[Veil Falls]], Gregal will thank him with the Light Arrows and the Bow of Light.{{Cite|Oh, it's Link! Thank you for your help earlier! I've got something else good for you, so here, please take it!|Gregal|TMC}} If Gregal is not saved before the Cloud Tops are reached via Veil Falls, he will have passed away and the Bow of Light will be impossible to obtain. Holding an [[Arrow]] with the Bow of Light will charge up a Light Arrow; if the Light Arrows are not charged, they will act as normal Arrows. ==={{TP|-}}=== The Bow of Light appears in the horseback phase of [[Ganondorf]]'s battle in {{TP}}. After [[Princess Zelda]] asks the [[Spirit of Light|Spirits of Light]] for a weapon against Ganondorf, she receives Light Arrows for the Bow of Light. When riding on [[Epona]], Link must lock on to Ganondorf so Princess Zelda can fire the Bow of Light at him, stunning him and allowing Link to attack him with the [[Master Sword]]. This version reappears in Breath of the Wild as the [[Twilight Bow]]. It has 30 base Attack and 100 base Durability. It is one of only 2 bows that fire Light Arrows, the other being the {{BotW}} version of the Bow of Light received in the final battle. Neither can fire the other arrows, and Light Arrows are generated by the bow itself, so they are infinite. This version can only be acquired when scanning the Smash series Zelda amiibo. It's randomly in the chest that drops, and can only appear if you've defeated at least 1 Divine Beast. ==={{ST|-}}=== The Bow of Light is obtained after defeating [[Skeldritch]] in the [[Sand Temple]] in {{ST}}. The Bow was once wielded by the [[Spirit of Good|Spirits of Good]] during their war against the Demon King, [[Malladus]].{{Cite|In the battle between the Demon King and the spirits, there was a weapon called the Bow of Light... Perhaps it can drive his spirit from your body.|Anjean|ST}} Following the war, the Bow of Light was placed in the depths of the Sand Temple deep in the heart of the [[Sand Realm]].{{Cite|Go to the final temple, the Sand Temple. The Bow of Light is located deep inside.|Anjean|ST}} If the Bow of Light is held down long enough, [[Light]] will be infused into an Arrow, turning it into a Light Arrow. If released quickly, the Bow will shoot a normal Arrow. In the battle within the [[Dark Realm]], Link must use the Bow of Light to shoot Malladus while Princess Zelda holds him in place, banishing Malladus' presence from Zelda's body. When Malladus takes over the body of [[Cole]], Link must distract the Demon King long enough for Princess Zelda to shoot a weak spot on his back with the Bow of Light, eventually creating an opening for Link to destroy Malladus' two horns protecting a crystal on his head.{{Cite|You distract Malladus, Link. When I see an opportunity, I'll shoot him in the back with the Bow of Light.|Princess Zelda|ST}} This leaves the crystal exposed, allowing Link to destroy it with the [[Lokomo Sword]]. ==={{ALBW|-}}=== The Bow of Light is obtained during the fight against [[Yuga Ganon]] in {{ALBW}}. After being successfully struck, Yuga Ganon [[Wall Merging|merges]] into a wall, thus becoming invulnerable. At this point, Princess Zelda, speaking through her [[Painting]], gives Link the Bow of Light. While wall merged, Link must shoot Light Arrows into Yuga Ganon's back to stun him, at which point he is forced to emerge from the wall and is left vulnerable to [[Sword]] strikes. Once this process is repeated twice more, Yuga Ganon is defeated. ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 100 |durability = 100 |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = No |throw = |distance = 500 |multiplier = |zoom = |reflect = |bash = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Bow of Light}} The Bow of Light is given to [[Link]] by [[Zelda]] before the final battle against [[Dark Beast Ganon]] in {{BotW}}. It has an attack power of 100, fires infinite [[Light Arrow]]s, and has infinite durability. Once obtained, Link must wait for Zelda to weaken Ganon's power, then shoot Light Arrows with the Bow of Light in the weak spots she creates. Once Dark Beast Ganon is sufficiently weakened, a [[Glowing Eyeball]] representing his very core and essence will appear on his forehead. If Link shoots Dark Beast Ganon's core with the Bow of Light, it will destroy his physical form. The Bow of Light used by Princess Zelda in {{TP|-}} can also be unlocked as a [[Weapon]] by using the {{SSB|-}} series Zelda [[amiibo]]. However, it is referred to as the [[Twilight Bow]]. {{BotW Bow Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Bow_071" |Life = 100 |Power = 100 |Range = 500.0 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 0 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 0 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 0 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 0 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 0 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 0 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 0 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 0 |PoweredSharpAddSpreadFire = false |PoweredSharpAddZoomRapid = false |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMin = 1.1 |PoweredSharpAddRapidFireMax = 1.3 |ArrowName = "BrightArrow" {{List Note|Light Arrow}} |IsLeadShot = false |LeadShotNum = 0 |LeadShotAng = 45.0 |IsRapidFire = false |RapidFireNum = 0 |ArrowGravity = -5.0 |ArrowChargeRate = 1.0 |ArrowReloadRate = 1.0 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{SSBB|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Main|[[Light Arrow#Super Smash Bros. Brawl|Light Arrow]]}} The Bow of Light appears as part of Zelda and [[Sheik]]'s [[Final Smash]] in {{SSBB}}. It also appears as a [[Sticker]], although it is referred to as the [[Hero's Bow]] instead. ====Sticker Information==== {{SSBSticker|header=yes}} {{#section:Sticker|Hero's Bow}} |} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{HW|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|HWDE}} The Bow of Light appears as a weapon in {{HW}}. It can be summoned as part of Zelda's combos and special attacks while wielding her [[Rapier]]s. [[Tetra]] is capable of doing the same in {{HWL}} as her [[Special Attack]] when in [[Focus Spirit]] mode. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{SSB4|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The Bow of Light appears once again as part of Zelda and Sheik's Final Smash in {{SSB4}}. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Zelda Bow }} {{Stub|AoC}} The Bow of Light is a [[Weapon]] that is used by Princess Zelda. She receives it after the [[Movie]] "[[At Last, an Awakening]]" plays during the [[Scenario]] "[[Each Step Like Thunder]]", wherein she is able to gain access to her power. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Items |category= Items in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * Name citation * Model and icon in the infobox * Where the Item is found * How much the Item costs, how much it can be sold for * What the Item is used for * If the Item is a Weapon, what ways the Weapon can be enhanced }} {{Stub|AoI}} The Bow of Light is used by [[Zelda]] during several attacks. Her default [[Strong Attack]] involves her summoning her [[Bow]], which she uses to shoot [[Light Arrow]]s at [[Enemy|Enemies]]. In addition, she utilizes it during both her default [[Sync Strike]]s and her Sync Strikes with [[Ardi]]. One of Zelda's [[Unique Skill]]s is also known as the [[Bow of Light (Ability)|Bow of Light]]. When it is activated, Zelda will shoot several Light Arrows upwards with her Bow, which is capable of [[Countering]] [[Dangerous Attack]]s from above. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ===Other Names=== {{Other Names |- | Light Arrow{{Cite|You got the {{Color TMC|Red|Light Arrow}}!
